info.title: Inspoter Public API
info.description: Public endpoints for ingesting workspace events, channel messages, and server metrics, plus the token-authenticated API for managing the Messages section.

post.description: Creates a channel message from a Discord Execute Webhook payload. The secret token is carried in the URL and must not be logged, persisted, or exposed. Accepts application/json and multipart/form-data; in multipart the body is read from the payload_json part and file parts are ignored.

200.description: The message was created and is returned as a Discord message object. Returned when wait is true.

204.description: The message was created. No body is returned.

400.description: The body could not be parsed, failed validation, or carried nothing displayable.

401.description: The webhook identifier or secret is invalid or revoked.

413.description: The request body exceeds the configured size limit.

429.description: The webhook exceeded its rate limit.

get.description: Returns the webhook as a Discord webhook object. Used by senders that probe the URL before their first delivery.

401.description: The webhook identifier or secret is invalid or revoked.

post.description: Slack incoming-webhook form of the same credential: text becomes the message content and each attachment becomes an embed. As on Discord, wait defaults to true here.

200.description: The message was created and is returned as a Discord message object. Returned unless wait is explicitly false.

204.description: The message was created. No body is returned.

400.description: The body could not be parsed, failed validation, or carried nothing displayable.

401.description: The webhook identifier or secret is invalid or revoked.

413.description: The request body exceeds the configured size limit.

429.description: The webhook exceeded its rate limit.

post.description: Streamable HTTP transport for MCP clients. The bearer token identifies the workspace and its scopes decide which tools `tools/list` advertises; a token with no MCP scopes is rejected as unauthorized. Serving is stateless, so GET and DELETE (session operations) answer 405.

200.description: The JSON-RPC exchange completed. The body is a JSON-RPC response, or an SSE stream of them when the server emits related messages before its result.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, malformed, revoked, channel-scoped, or carries no MCP scopes.

405.description: The method is not allowed on this stateless endpoint.

429.description: The per-token rate limit was exceeded.

post.description: Accepts a metrics snapshot from a monitoring agent. The token identifies the workspace; once bound to a server the snapshot updates its latest reading. An unbound token triggers enrollment.

200.description: The snapshot was accepted for an already-enrolled server.

201.description: The monitoring agent was enrolled and its first snapshot was stored.

400.description: The JSON body is missing, unparseable, or fails schema validation.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, malformed, invalid, expired, or revoked.

409.description: The reported addresses conflict with another server or the match is ambiguous.

413.description: The request body exceeds the 16 KiB size limit.

422.description: The schema version is unsupported or the capturedAt timestamp is too far in the future.

429.description: The token has exceeded its submission rate limit.

503.description: A configured provider's inventory API is temporarily unavailable.

get.description: Requires the bookmarks:read scope. Answers a flat list across every category; omit `query` to list them all. This is the only HTTP read of the bookmark tree.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the name, url or description.

post.description: Requires the bookmarks:write scope. The category must already exist; the bookmark is appended to its end.

get.description: Requires the bookmarks:read scope. Top-level categories, each carrying its subcategories.

post.description: Requires the bookmarks:write scope. Passing parentCategoryId nests the category under an existing top-level one; nesting deeper is rejected.

patch.description: Requires the bookmarks:write scope.

patch.summary: Rename or re-parent a bookmark category
patch.description: Requires the bookmarks:write scope. Deleting a category is deliberately not exposed — it cascades to every bookmark inside it and stays an operator action in the dashboard.

get.description: Requires the bookmarks:read scope. Only the hostname of the supplied address is looked up — the address itself is never fetched.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The bookmark address whose icon should be inferred.

patch.description: Requires the bookmarks:write scope. Sets the order inside one category, or moves a bookmark between two.

get.description: Requires the bookmarks:read scope.

patch.description: Requires the bookmarks:write scope.

delete.description: Requires the bookmarks:write scope. The category is left alone.

get.description: Requires the contacts:read scope. query matches names, organization, email and phone; a phone number matches with or without its formatting. The token identifies the workspace, so no workspace parameter is involved.

post.description: Requires the contacts:write scope.

patch.summary: Act on many contacts at once
patch.description: Requires the contacts:write scope. Stars, unstars, labels, unlabels or deletes up to 1000 contacts in one call.

get.description: Requires the contacts:read scope. Groups records that share an email, a phone number or a display name; feed a group's ids straight into the merge operation.
Requires the contacts:read scope. Answers the serialized file as text rather than as a download. Select either explicit ids or the same filters the list operation takes.

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: Repeat the parameter to select specific contacts.

post.description: Requires the contacts:write scope. Accepts vCard 2.1/3.0/4.0, Google CSV, Outlook CSV and LDIF; the format is detected from the content unless it is given.

duplicateStrategy.description: What to do when a record with the same email, phone or name already exists.

get.description: Requires the contacts:read scope. Ids from here are the labelIds the create and update operations accept.

post.description: Requires the contacts:write scope. Label names are unique per workspace, case-insensitively.

409.description: A label with this name already exists, or the workspace label limit is reached.

patch.description: Requires the contacts:write scope.

delete.description: Requires the contacts:write scope. Contacts carrying the label keep their other labels.

post.description: Requires the contacts:write scope. Folds every record in otherIds into the primary and deletes them. This cannot be undone.

get.description: Requires the contacts:read scope. Matches the address itself and the contact's searchable text, so a person's name finds their address. One entry per address, not per contact.
Requires the contacts:read scope. Returns every email, phone, address, label and note the contact carries.

404.description: No contact with this id exists in the workspace.

patch.description: Requires the contacts:write scope. fields, addresses and labelIds are replaced wholesale: send the full list the contact should end up with.

404.description: No contact with this id exists in the workspace.

delete.description: Requires the contacts:write scope. Deletes the contact and everything attached to it.

200.description: The id of the deleted contact.

404.description: No contact with this id exists in the workspace.

get.description: Requires the contacts:read scope. Answers the image bytes, or 404 when the contact carries no photo.

post.description: Requires the contacts:write scope. JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP only — an SVG would be an XSS vector served same-origin.

415.description: The uploaded file is not one of the accepted image types.

get.description: Requires the kanban:read scope. Board summaries with their column and card counts.

post.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. The board starts empty. Deleting a board or a column is deliberately not exposed: either takes every card, checklist item and comment inside it, and that stays an operator action in the dashboard.

patch.description: Requires the kanban:write scope.

get.description: Requires the kanban:read scope. The board in full: every column with the cards it holds.

patch.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. Deleting a board or a column is deliberately not exposed: either takes every card, checklist item and comment inside it, and that stays an operator action in the dashboard.

get.description: Requires the kanban:read scope. A flat list across every board; omit `query` to list them all.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the title, a label, or the linked record.

parameters.name: openOnly
parameters.description: Exclude cards sitting in a terminal column.

post.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. Fires the card-created outgoing webhook.

patch.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. Rewrites the card order of the source and destination columns in one transaction. Moving into a terminal column completes the card and fires the completed webhook.

get.description: Requires the kanban:read scope.

patch.description: Requires the kanban:write scope.

delete.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. The card's checklist and comments go with it.

get.description: Requires the kanban:read scope.

200.description: The checklist items in display order.

post.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. Appends to the checklist.

get.description: Requires the kanban:read scope. Oldest first.

post.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. The comment is attributed to the API token, so the board shows which agent wrote it — and only that token can remove it again.

put.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. Replaces the whole set; an empty array clears it.

patch.description: Requires the kanban:write scope.

post.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. Deleting a board or a column is deliberately not exposed: either takes every card, checklist item and comment inside it, and that stays an operator action in the dashboard.

patch.description: Requires the kanban:write scope.

Requires the kanban:write scope. Deleting a board or a column is deliberately not exposed: either takes every card, checklist item and comment inside it, and that stays an operator action in the dashboard.

delete.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. Only the author may remove a comment, so a token can delete only what it wrote; anything else answers the same non-disclosing 404 a foreign id would.

get.description: Requires the kanban:read scope. Ids from here are the labelIds the card operations accept.

post.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. Label names are unique per workspace, case-insensitively.

patch.description: Requires the kanban:write scope.

delete.description: Requires the kanban:write scope. Cards carrying the label keep their other labels.

get.summary: List records a card can link to
get.description: Requires the kanban:read scope. The servers, domains, services, alerts and hosting accounts a card can be linked to, grouped by type: an entry's id is a card's linkedId and its name the linkedLabel snapshot.
Requires the mail:read scope. Metadata only — read one message for its body. `query` matches the subject, the sender address and the sender name.

Requires the mail:read scope. Passwords are never returned. Creating, editing and deleting a mail account is deliberately not exposed: an account carries IMAP and SMTP credentials, and those stay an operator action in the dashboard.
Requires the mail:read scope. Ids from here are the folderId the move operation takes.

200.description: The account's folders with their unread counts.

post.description: Requires the mail:write scope. Fetches new mail outside the account's schedule. Exactly one syncer per account: a second caller is told to wait rather than queued behind the first.

409.description: A sync of this account is already running.

post.description: Requires the mail:write scope. Saves the draft in the account's Drafts folder; omit draftId to create one, pass it to overwrite.

get.description: Requires the mail:read scope. In evaluation order, each with the outcome of its most recent backfill run.

post.description: Requires the mail:write scope. The rule labels incoming mail and may also mark it read or move it.

patch.description: Requires the mail:write scope.

delete.description: Requires the mail:write scope. The labels it already applied stay on the messages that carry them.

get.description: Requires the mail:read scope. How far the run has swept the account's existing mail, and why it stopped if it failed.

post.description: Requires the mail:write scope. A run that is pending, running or already finished is refused.

409.description: The run is not in a state that can be retried.

get.description: Requires the mail:read scope. Ids from here are the labelId the assignment and rule operations take.

post.description: Requires the mail:write scope. Label names are unique per workspace, case-insensitively.

patch.description: Requires the mail:write scope.

delete.description: Requires the mail:write scope. A label a filter rule still points at cannot be removed — retarget or delete the rule first.

post.description: Requires the mail:write scope. Sends over the account's SMTP transport and files a copy in Sent. This cannot be undone, and a separate per-workspace send limit applies on top of the per-token rate limit.

201.description: The filed copy, when there is one.

get.description: Requires the mail:read scope. The full body and attachment metadata; attachment bytes come from their own operation.

patch.summary: Mark a message read or unread
patch.description: Requires the mail:write scope. The flag is pushed to the IMAP server as well as stored locally.

delete.description: Requires the mail:write scope. Moves the message to the account's Trash; deleting from Trash — or from an account without one — is permanent.

get.description: Requires the mail:read scope. The bytes are base64-encoded so the response keeps this family's JSON envelope. An attachment above the workspace size ceiling is refused rather than truncated.

put.summary: Put a label on a message
put.description: Requires the mail:write scope. Assigning a label the message already carries changes nothing.

delete.summary: Take a label off a message

post.summary: Move a message to another folder
post.description: Requires the mail:write scope. The destination must belong to the same account.

get.summary: List message categories and their channels
get.description: Requires the messages:read scope. The token identifies the workspace, so no workspace parameter is involved.

200.description: The workspace's categories, each with its channels.

post.description: Requires the messages:write scope. Get-or-create by name: names are matched case-insensitively, so repeating a request answers 200 with the existing category instead of duplicating it.

200.description: A category with this name already existed and was returned unchanged.

patch.description: Requires the messages:write scope. Deleting a category is deliberately not part of this API — it would cascade to every channel and message inside it.

404.description: No such category, channel, or webhook exists in the token's workspace.

post.description: Requires the messages:write scope. Get-or-create by name within the category, so repeating a request answers 200 with the existing channel.

200.description: A channel with this name already existed in the category.

404.description: No such category, channel, or webhook exists in the token's workspace.

get.description: Requires the messages:read scope.

patch.description: Requires the messages:write scope. Deleting a channel is deliberately not part of this API — it would take the channel's message history with it.

404.description: No such category, channel, or webhook exists in the token's workspace.

get.description: Requires the messages:read scope. Keyset pagination: pass the previous response's nextCursor to continue.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's nextCursor.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Ordering by creation time; defaults to desc.

404.description: No such category, channel, or webhook exists in the token's workspace.

post.summary: Post a message to a channel
post.description: Requires the messages:write scope. The message is stored with origin AGENT, so the dashboard shows it came from an API token. Messages cannot be edited or deleted afterwards.

404.description: No such category, channel, or webhook exists in the token's workspace.

post.description: Requires the messages:write scope. Read state is per channel and workspace-wide — this is the same action opening the channel in the dashboard performs.

get.description: Requires the messages:read scope. Secrets are never returned — only the prefix and the usage timestamps.

404.description: No such category, channel, or webhook exists in the token's workspace.

post.description: Requires the messages:write scope. The response carries the only copy of the webhook URL with its secret; it cannot be retrieved again afterwards.

201.description: The webhook was created; url contains the secret and is shown once.

404.description: No such category, channel, or webhook exists in the token's workspace.

delete.description: Requires the messages:write scope. Calls made with the webhook URL stop working immediately; the row itself is kept, and messages already posted are untouched.

404.description: No such category, channel, or webhook exists in the token's workspace.

get.description: Requires the services:read scope. Returns every monitored service with its labels and its 24 most recent checks.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the name, description, url or host.

schema.description: PENDING until the first check completes.

post.description: Requires the services:write scope. The first check runs immediately after creation.

get.description: Requires the services:read scope. Ids from here are the labelIds the service operations accept.

post.description: Requires the services:write scope. Label names are unique per workspace, case-insensitively.

patch.description: Requires the services:write scope. Renames or recolors one label.

delete.description: Requires the services:write scope. Services carrying the label keep their other labels.

get.description: Requires the services:read scope.

patch.description: Requires the services:write scope. Changing the target or the interval re-checks the service immediately. Send only isActive to pause or resume it.

delete.description: Requires the services:write scope. The service's check history goes with it and this cannot be undone.

post.description: Requires the services:write scope. Runs one check outside the schedule and answers with the service carrying its fresh status. A paused service can be checked this way too.

get.description: Requires the services:read scope. Newest first, cursor-paginated.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's nextCursor.

post.description: Creates a message in the channel associated with the webhook. The secret token is carried in the URL and must not be logged, persisted, or exposed.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Sensitive channel webhook secret. Redact this value from logs and telemetry.

200.description: An idempotent replay was accepted and the existing message identifier is returned.

400.description: The JSON body, payload, or Idempotency-Key is invalid.

401.description: The channel webhook identifier or secret is invalid or revoked.

413.description: The request body exceeds the configured size limit.

429.description: The channel webhook has exceeded its rate limit.

post.description: Creates a log, alert, mail item, or channel message using a workspace webhook token. A previously processed Idempotency-Key may return the original identifier with status 200. Concurrent requests with the same key retain at-least-once behavior.

value.message: Response time is above the target

alertWithoutCategory.summary: Service alert from a sender that has no categories

429.description: The webhook token has exceeded its rate limit.

WebhookBearer.description: Workspace webhook token issued by Inspoter.

LegacyIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
LegacyIdempotencyKey.description: Optional caller-defined replay key. Legacy ingestion accepts this header without format or length constraints and provides at-least-once behavior under concurrent requests.

ChannelIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ChannelIdempotencyKey.description: Optional replay key containing 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters.

DiscordWebhookId.name: webhookId
DiscordWebhookId.description: Channel webhook identifier. The same value the native channel route uses.

DiscordWebhookToken.name: token
DiscordWebhookToken.description: Sensitive channel webhook secret. Redact this value from logs and telemetry.

DiscordWait.name: wait
DiscordWait.description: When true the response is 200 with the created message object; otherwise 204 with no body.

DiscordThreadId.name: thread_id
DiscordThreadId.description: Accepted for Discord compatibility and ignored: Inspoter channels have no threads.

DiscordWithComponents.name: with_components
DiscordWithComponents.description: Accepted for Discord compatibility and ignored: message components are not rendered.

ContactId.name: contactId
ContactId.description: Contact id, as returned by the list operation.

ServiceId.name: serviceId
ServiceId.description: Service id, as returned by the list operation.

BookmarkId.description: Bookmark id, as returned by the list operation.

BookmarkCategoryId.description: Bookmark category id, as returned by the category list.

ContactLabelId.name: labelId
ContactLabelId.description: Contact label id, as returned by the label list operation.

KanbanBoardId.name: boardId
KanbanBoardId.description: Board id, as returned by the board list.

KanbanColumnId.name: columnId
KanbanColumnId.description: Column id, as returned by the board detail.

KanbanCardId.name: cardId
KanbanCardId.description: Card id, as returned by the card search.

KanbanChecklistItemId.name: itemId
KanbanChecklistItemId.description: Checklist item id, as returned by the checklist list.

KanbanCommentId.name: commentId

MailAttachmentId.name: attachmentId

MailFilterRuleId.name: ruleId

MailFilterRunId.name: runId

ValidationFailed.description: The request body or query string failed validation.

Unauthorized.description: The bearer token is missing, malformed, revoked, channel-scoped, or carries no MCP scopes.

Forbidden.description: The token lacks the scope this operation requires.

RateLimited.description: The per-token rate limit was exceeded.

NotFound.description: The path names a resource that does not exist in the token's workspace.

LabelConflict.description: A label with this name already exists, or the workspace label limit is reached.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The upload is larger than this workspace allows.

LimitReached.description: A workspace, board or column limit is already reached.

UpstreamFailed.description: The mail server refused or dropped the request. Nothing was changed locally.

ReferrerPolicy.description: Prevents the sensitive webhook URL from being sent as referrer information.

WwwAuthenticate.description: Announces bearer authentication for the MCP endpoint.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed inside the current fixed window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests still allowed inside the current window.

RateLimitReset.description: Unix time at which the window resets, in seconds with millisecond precision.

RateLimitResetAfter.description: Seconds until the window resets, with millisecond precision.

RateLimitBucket.description: Opaque rate-limit bucket identifier. One channel webhook is one bucket.

RateLimitScope.description: Scope of the exceeded limit. Always user for a channel webhook.

RateLimitGlobal.description: Whether a global limit was hit. Always false: Inspoter has no global webhook limit.

category.description: Optional. Matched case-insensitively against existing categories and created on first use. Omit it and the alert is stored without a category, ready to be assigned in the dashboard.

content.description: Message content. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed before validation.

author.description: Optional author name. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed before validation.

method.description: MCP method, e.g. initialize, tools/list, tools/call.

DiscordEmbed.description: Discord embed object. The combined length of every title, description, footer text, author name and field name/value across all embeds of one request must not exceed 6000 characters.

DiscordAllowedMentions.description: Validated for shape and then ignored: Inspoter sends no mention notifications.

DiscordExecuteWebhookPayload.description: Discord Execute Webhook body. Unknown properties are ignored, matching Discord. At least one of content, embeds, components or poll must be present.

username.description: Shown as the message author. Defaults to the webhook name.

flags.description: Message flags bitfield. SUPPRESS_EMBEDS (4) drops the embeds before storage.

attachments.description: Accepted and ignored: channel messages have no attachment storage.

SlackWebhookPayload.description: Slack incoming-webhook body. text becomes the message content and each attachment becomes an embed. channel, icon_emoji, mrkdwn and mrkdwn_in are not supported.

DiscordMessage.description: Discord message object. Fields Inspoter has no equivalent for are null or empty.

id.description: Surrogate snowflake derived from the internal identifier. Not reversible and never accepted as input.

code.description: Discord JSON error code: 50035 invalid form body, 50006 empty message, 40005 body too large, 10015 unknown webhook, 0 general.

errors.description: Per-field error tree. Every leaf is an _errors array of { code, message } entries.

origin.description: AGENT marks a message written by an API token, whether over this API or the MCP endpoint.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when the last page was returned.

tokenPrefix.description: First characters of the secret, for identification in the dashboard only.

url.description: Relative ingest URL containing the webhook secret. Returned once, at creation, and never again.

author.description: Display name for the message; defaults to the API token's name.

displayName.description: Derived from the name parts, falling back to the nickname, the organization and then the first email address.

birthday.description: ISO-8601 date, or "--MM-DD" when the year is unknown.

color.description: A preset name (SLATE, RED, AMBER, GREEN, BLUE, VIOLET) or a #RRGGBB value.

label.description: Free-form. Well-known values are "home", "work", "mobile", "main", "fax", "workFax", "homeFax", "pager" and "other"; anything else came from an imported file and is kept verbatim.

formatted.description: The source's own one-line rendering, when it carried one.
